headline: Gutter Reignites While Weathered Expanse Battle Grinds On
war_summary: Three hours have redrawn the active fronts. Gutter, quiet at the last wire, has flared to 11 changes in two hours and 73 on the day around Kuoppa, The Parras and Salaoja Road, holding five Warden, one Colonial and one neutral, while Weathered Expanse has eased to four in two hours and 44 on the day around Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, now five Warden, two Colonial and two neutral. Nevish Line has cooled to three in two hours and 21 on the day around Blackcoat Way and Tomb Father, now eight Warden with no Colonial or neutral ground recorded. Palantine Berm has stirred to two in two hours and 24 on the day around Vendett and Underlook at six Colonial to one neutral, and Linn Mercy shows two in two hours and four on the day at Outwich Ranch at one Warden, eight Colonial and two neutral, with Farranac Coast logging two at the cutoff at Transient Valley at one Warden to ten Colonial. Marban Hollow, busy earlier with 20 on the day at Oster Wall, records none in two hours. Callahan's Passage still bears the heaviest daily toll above ten thousand Colonial and seven thousand Warden casualties with Stonecradle above two and four thousand, neither with a recorded change.
